name: calendar-rac
blurb: Date or range picker using React Aria Components.
description: A DayPicker built on React Aria Components, supporting both single date and date range selection with keyboard navigation.
use_when: You need an accessible calendar with keyboard support.
avoid_when: When you need a lightweight calendar without external accessibility libraries.
a11y: Full keyboard navigation via React Aria. aria-label and role attributes on all interactive elements.
